findings.evidence: The new doctest unit runs `cargo test --doc -p CRATE [--features SET]` directly. The comment at :21 notes nextest skips doctests. No per-test slow-timeout/terminate-after applies, so a hanging doctest stalls the round with no round.json and no TIMEOUT record. This breaks CX-VAL-005 ('run every test ... under a per-test timeout') and CX-EXEC-005, which also forbids wrapping the whole run in a timeout.
findings.remediation: Give each doctest a per-test watchdog that records TIMEOUT, or get a lead exemption for doctests

findings.evidence: A declared feature set that the crate manifest lacks is recorded feature_absent and has no exit impact. Renaming or dropping reel `av1`, motion-js `quickjs` or type `harfrust` would silently stop their feature-gated tests while the round exit stays 0. Nothing checks that a feature unit ran more tests than the default unit.
findings.remediation: Make feature_absent for a declared (crate, set) an infrastructure exit, or report it in the summary line
